production_output.encoding: UTF-8 strict JSON with final LF; unique keys; no NaN/Infinity/trailing data
production_output.inputs: exact full typed profile.inputs array; no identities

roots.arrays: explicit even empty; sorted catalog_index then record_ordinal

occurrence.catalog_index: exact nonnegative int from catalog.catalog_index; never bool/float
occurrence.record_ordinal: exact nonnegative int from unchanged row.ordinal, equal zero-based JSONL line
occurrence.file_candidate: exact bool: GRF/GPF metadata_filter==eligible, RGZ opcode==f; other observations retained as false
occurrence.record: complete unchanged typed raw input dictionary, including all flags/sizes/offsets/hashes/nulls/name/opcode fields; embedded paths/spans inert
occurrence.multiplicity: keep every physical-source record, including duplicates/filtered/non-file; shared catalog views do not duplicate records

matching.source_name: GRF/GPF name_hex; RGZ bounded_name_hex; decode hex bytes only
matching.key: replace backslash with slash then fold ASCII A-Z to a-z, preserving every other byte/segment
matching.full: complete key equals expected key; raw_exact only byte-identical raw vs expected Windows name, otherwise ascii_slash_casefold
matching.basename: only when full key differs but final slash component equals expected final component; diagnostic basename_only

counter_rules.full_path_file_candidates: sum true file_candidate in full arrays
counter_rules.basename_only_file_candidates: sum true file_candidate in basename arrays
counter_rules.roots_with_full_path: number of distinct roots with nonempty full array
counter_rules.roots_with_full_path_file_candidates: number of distinct roots with any true candidate in full array

counts.types: all counters exact nonnegative int, never bool/float; derive from complete scan

fixture.output: one flat array ordered target input order then catalog_index then record_ordinal; each occurrence adds target_id to production occurrence shape
fixture.input_shape: targets non-dense exact nonnegative target_id with expected_name_hex; catalogs physical catalog_index/family/views/records; use same matching/file_candidate logic; never duplicate shared views
fixture.expected: root literal golden retained privately before provider inspection; each complete typed raw record must survive

method.scope: authored stdlib metadata operations only; no acquired imports or embedded path traversal
method.publication: create new0700 directory and0600 files exclusively, never replace existing output; finite caps; report refusal honestly
method.preservation: full83 hashes and no-follow regular/single-link descriptor/path identities before/after; root checks independently

claims.gnd_gat: unobserved same-stem candidates, missing RSW embedded filenames unknown
claims.empty: no counterpart under this byte policy within these catalogs only
